title: Glide 3.4.1 — now for every car 🏎️
body:
🔌⛽ Glide now help you track your energy consumption per car profile! — electric, hybrid or petrol — log fill-ups/charges so you can learn more about your expenses.

📉 See what you actually consumed. The efficiency chart now plots the real kWh/100 km (or L/100 km) from your own energy log, measured pack to pack across each leg. Now you can see how much your improved driving saves real $$ at the pump.

💾 New master backup packs your cars, trip's score and your whole energy log small enough to keep in Drive — and to restore from on a new phone.
